en: Colorized vintage view of an outdoor fairground with a large circular airship-themed carousel in the center reading "Zeppelin IV" and "Parseval V." Visitors in early‑20th‑century clothing stroll along paths and stand near the ride; tents and smaller attractions are visible in the background, with trees surrounding the fair. The caption at the top is printed in red German script.
